question: Find the names of all cards illustrated by artists who have also created cards with Japanese translations, where those cards are either non-foil-only or lack powerful foils (i.e., missing either cardKingdomId or cardKingdomFoilId). Additionally, include whether each such card has sensitive content.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_049", c."XCL_064"
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c2."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS c2
    INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c2."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
    WHERE fd."XCL_077" = 'Japanese'
)
AND (c."XCL_007" IS NULL OR c."XCL_006" IS NULL)
